definition: The class of things able to be assigned a unique, persistent identifier (a.k.a. OID).  Objects that are used, but not created or managed, by an application must be members of subclasses of Identifiable so that their information can be accessed by an application and stored in a database; classes of objects whose information is managed by an Organization must be subclasses of ManagedObject, which identifies the organizational ownership of objects within an application.
name: Identifiable
